correctness.rationale: The two parameterizations are complete and one-to-one modulo rotation: 65536 nonsingular feedback functions filtered to one Hamiltonian orbit, and anchored Euler tours in the 4-bit overlap graph. Exact polynomial divisibility and independent Berlekamp–Massey yield the same linear complexity; prefix ranges and full interval enumeration yield the same discrepancy. Both independent 2048-row censuses agree on every joint cell.

value.rationale: The two objective functions evaluate complementary constraints on pseudorandom cyclic sequences: local bias and recurrence predictability. At the first nontrivial finite case with both distributions spanning several values, the exact 92-cycle Pareto corner and complete joint distribution distinguish simultaneous optimization from marginal attainment; neither implication nor mere renaming of known counts.
